entities.name: Karoliina Lundahl

entities.summary: Satu Karoliina Lundahl, née Leppäluoto is a retired female weightlifter from Finland, who was nicknamed "Kartsi" during her career. She started as a shot putter, competing for her native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics.
